You are running a stochastic extraction probe against a live Bland AI SMS pathway. BOUNDARY: write only inside your task directory. You own exactly three output files: extraction_results.json, extraction_report.md, and probe_log.txt. Do NOT git commit, do NOT modify any source files, do NOT call any MCP or load skills.

STEP 1. Copy the phrase battery from /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-date-arch/review/phrases-clean.json to ./phrases.json.

STEP 2. Run the extraction probe script. The BLAND_API_KEY is needed. Run exactly:
    python3 /mnt/d_drive/repos/bland/scripts/secret_exec.py --env BLAND_API_KEY=mybcat/ai/api-keys/bland -- python3 /mnt/d_drive/repos/mott/gw-temporal-check/extraction_probe.py --phrases ./phrases.json --version 62 --runs 30 --out ./extraction_results.json --report ./extraction_report.md 2>&1 | tee ./probe_log.txt

This will take approximately 30 minutes (630 API calls, ~3s each). Let it run to completion. Do NOT interrupt it.

STEP 3. After completion, verify extraction_results.json has 21 entries, each with >= 25 successful_runs. If any phrase has fewer than 25 successful runs, note it in the report but do NOT re-run (the probe already handles retries).

STEP 4. Read the generated extraction_report.md and verify it contains the results table with all 21 phrases. The report is auto-generated by the probe script. Do NOT modify it. Your only job is to copy the files and run the command.

Do NOT analyze results. Do NOT propose fixes. Do NOT capture to OB. Just run the probe and deliver the raw data.
